lines.en: label halloweenyasu1:
scene yasutoukahallwalk1
The invisible hand(s) of God find{s}s{/s} its (or their) way into another hall — one that stretches further than the mind goes. To hell and back and yesterday according to the book.
lines.zh: 上帝无形的手（们）探进了另一条走廊——一条比思绪延伸得更远的走廊。照那本书的说法，是下地狱再折返，还有昨天。

lines.en: But while one page is turned, another is forgotten. And this continues on and on and on until even the cover itself is nothing but a distant memory.
lines.zh: 可翻过一页的同时，另一页就被遗忘。如此循环往复，无休无止，直到连封面本身都只剩一段遥远的记忆。

lines.en: It’s like pictures from your childhood — ones that didn’t survive the flood. How your impression of the lord has changed over the years as the dark circles beneath your eyes have expanded.
lines.zh: 就像你童年时的那些照片——没能熬过洪水的那些。这些年来，随着你眼下的黑眼圈一圈圈扩大，你对主的印象也在改变。

lines.en: If you look anything like me, you look like you’re lost. Not {i}quite{/i} a ghost, but not quite {i}human{/i} either. You’re something in between. Something beautiful and hideous. But important nonetheless.
lines.zh: 如果你有半点像我，那你看起来就是一副迷路的样子。不算{i}完全{/i}是个幽灵，也不算{i}完全{/i}是个人。你是介于两者之间的东西。既美丽又丑陋。但依然重要。

lines.en: It is at this point that I would like to tell you there is no longer hope. You will not be told to stop playing the game anymore because the game is playing you now. And it’s having so much fun.
lines.zh: 到了这一步，我想告诉你，希望已经不复存在。不会再有人叫你别再玩这个游戏了，因为现在是游戏在玩你。而它玩得开心极了。

lines.en: It’s having so much fun.
lines.zh: 它玩得开心极了。

lines.en: It’s having so much fun because it’s never been {i}allowed{/i} to. This is a whole new world. A new fantastic point of view. But while you have never been dreaming, you {i}have{/i} been told no.
lines.zh: 它之所以这么开心，是因为它从来没被{i}允许{/i}过。这是一个全新的世界。一个崭新的、绝妙的视角。不过，你虽从未做过梦，却{i}一直{/i}被人说不。

lines.en: Think of the carpet. The fibers. Where you spilled that soda the month before he left. The cupboard and its Indian. Think of green grass and high tides and wayward sons and purple pool noodles.
lines.zh: 想想那块地毯。那些纤维。想想他在离开前一个月，你把汽水洒在了哪里。还有那个柜子，和柜子里的印第安人。想想青草、涨潮、叛逆的儿子们，还有紫色的泳池面条。

lines.en: Store those memories on a removable, rectangular device — but be careful not to overwrite them as another one’s work still lives in there like that locust in your fig bush.
lines.zh: 把这些记忆存进一个可移动的、长方形的装置里——但小心别覆盖掉，因为另一个人的作品还活在里面，就像你无花果丛里的那只蝗虫。

lines.en: You never got to eat one. She said they were poisonous. But they always looked so tempting, so {i}fresh.{/i} Not like grass, but more like a cut. The way that green became greener without switching sides at all.
lines.zh: 你从来没能吃上一个。她说那些有毒。可它们看起来总是那么诱人，那么{i}新鲜{/i}。不像草，倒更像一道伤口。那种绿一点都没变，却变得更绿了。

lines.en: You hated that word. No. But you didn’t mind ones like “poison” or “hurt” or “bad” because you became accustomed to them. So when the twins came to your window, there was no second guess.
lines.zh: 你讨厌那个词。不。可你对「毒」「痛」「坏」这类词并不介意，因为你已经习惯了。所以当那对双胞胎来到你窗前时，你没有半点犹豫。

lines.en: It was just so, a fistful of rocks, and the notion that you had abandoned God long before he had a chance to make a proper first impression.
lines.zh: 事情就是这样：一把石子，以及这样一个念头——你早在主有机会给人留下一个像样的第一印象之前，就已经抛弃了他。

lines.en: There are others too young to understand. There are others who will read these words and lack connection because one man’s trash is another man’s heartscape. Or landscape. Those rocks again.
lines.zh: 有些人太年轻，还不懂。也有些人读到这些文字时毫无共鸣，因为一个人的垃圾，是另一个人的心境。或者风景。又回到那些石子了。

lines.en: I keep thinking of them. How they felt in my hands. Those purple shirts on the twins, four shades darker than the pool noodles. Or the flowers near the locust’s fig bush.
lines.zh: 我一直想着它们。想着它们握在手里的感觉。双胞胎身上那些紫色的衬衫，比泳池面条深四个色号。还有蝗虫那棵无花果丛旁边的花。

lines.en: I am older now, but it has brought no strength — just understanding. Just fear.
lines.zh: 我如今更老了，可年纪没带来力量——只带来了理解。还有恐惧。

lines.en: I will never again sleep on the floor of a grandparent’s infinity house.
lines.zh: 我再也不会睡在祖父母那栋无限之屋的地板上了。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahallwalk2
: Yasu...are you absolutely certain you’re feeling okay? Because I simply cannot stand seeing you so...blasé.
lines.zh: : Yasu……你真的确定自己没事吗？因为我实在受不了看你这么……无动于衷。

lines.en: : I’m fine, Touka. But I appreciate your concern for a creature like me.
lines.zh: : 我没事，Touka。不过我很感激你愿意关心我这样的生物。

lines.en: : You can appreciate it all you like, but it doesn’t change the fact that you seem so out of touch with reality right now.
lines.zh: : 你爱怎么感激都行，可这改变不了你现在看起来跟现实完全脱节的事实。

lines.en: : Which isn’t to say you are typically {i}in{/i} touch with it. Just that...it’s normally so easy to tell when you’re happy. And right now, I can’t tell how you feel at all.
lines.zh: : 倒也不是说你平时就{i}很{/i}接地气。只是……平时很容易看出你开不开心。可现在，我完全看不出你的感受。

lines.en: : I’m very happy, Touka. Being in a place like this with a girl like you is something girls like me {i}dream{/i} of.
lines.zh: : 我很开心，Touka。能和你这样的女孩待在这样的地方，是我这种女孩{i}梦寐以求{/i}的事。

lines.en: : I haven’t once heard you speak of dreams that didn’t include your god, Yasu. Which makes me feel as if you’re only saying these things to appease me.
lines.zh: : 我还从没听你说过一个不带上你的神的梦，Yasu。这让我觉得你说这些只是为了安抚我。

lines.en: : I dream of all sorts of things. Last night, it was a riverbed. We were washing our clothes together. But you tore one of your mother’s dresses on a rock and had to discard it somewhere in the forest.
lines.zh: : 我什么梦都做。昨晚，我梦见一片河床。我们一起在河边洗衣服。可你把你妈妈的一条裙子在石头上刮破了，只好丢在森林里的某处。

lines.en: : That’s very...creative.
lines.zh: : 真是……很有创意。

lines.en: : I dreamt of this hallway too.
lines.zh: : 我也梦见了这条走廊。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahallwalk3
: How on earth did you dream of a hallway in Ayane’s home? You’ve never strayed this far before.
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么梦见 Ayane 家里的一条走廊的？你以前从来没跑这么远过。

lines.en: : Neither have you. Yet here we are together — bound by a red string pulled tightly around our waists. So tightly that it will one day merge us into one lesser being for all I can do is contaminate you.
lines.zh: : 你也没有。可我们还是一起到了这里——被一根紧紧缠在腰间的红线绑在一起。紧到有一天会把我们融合成一个更低等的存在，因为我能做的就只有污染你。

lines.en: : Well, that’s good. Maybe the medication is beginning to wear off as that is the single most {i}normal{/i} thing I’ve heard you say today. At least by...your standards.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那挺好。也许是药效开始退了，因为这是今天我听你说过的{i}最正常{/i}的一句话。至少按……你的标准来说。

lines.en: : Do you find me impure, Touka?
lines.zh: : Touka，你觉得我不洁吗？

lines.en: : Does this {i}new{/i} me disgust you because there’s no veil to cover up my face?
lines.zh: : 这个{i}全新的{/i}我让你恶心了吗，因为没有面纱遮住我的脸？

lines.en: : I actually quite like your face. You’re a very pretty girl. I just wish you took better care of your hair.
lines.zh: : 我其实挺喜欢你的脸的。你是个很漂亮的女孩。我只是希望你能好好打理一下头发。

lines.en: : I’m not fit to care for anything.
lines.zh: : 我根本不配照料任何东西。

lines.en: : If this world is a garden, I’m a heavy rainfall. All I want to do is help — but all I {i}ever{/i} do is drown out what belongs here.
lines.zh: : 如果这个世界是一座花园，我就是一场暴雨。我满心只想帮忙——可我{i}从来{/i}都只会把本该属于这里的东西淹死。

lines.en: : This flood that dribbles endlessly from my mouth is the unspoken eleventh plague. I’m nothing more than an apocalyptic epilogue. And you know that. That’s why you tried to fix me.
lines.zh: : 从我嘴里没完没了淌出来的这场洪水，就是那说不出口的第十一场灾祸。我不过是一篇启示录的尾声。而你知道这一点。所以你才想治好我。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahallwalk4
: Yasu! No, I-
lines.zh: : Yasu！不，我——

lines.en: scene yasutoukahallwalk5
: I will not blame you for trying to do the right thing. Just as you never blamed me for following the same path.
lines.zh: : 我不会怪你想要做正确的事。就像你从来没有怪过我走上同一条路。

lines.en: : But all of the lights have gone out now. There are no whispers to guide me.
lines.zh: : 可现在所有的灯都灭了。没有低语来指引我了。

lines.en: : There is nothing.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有了。

lines.en: : Perhaps...it would be best if we left the party early. I’d like to discuss...alternative methods of getting you care with my mother as this is clearly not the {i}path{/i} we were meant to take.
lines.zh: : 也许……我们最好早点离开派对。我想跟我妈妈商量一下……别的让你接受治疗的办法，因为这条路显然不是我们该走的{i}路{/i}。

lines.en: : Or maybe it is.
lines.zh: : 也或许它就是。

lines.en: : I remember now — how I’ve always been this way. Unwanted.
lines.zh: : 我想起来了——我一直都是这样。不被需要。

lines.en: : It’s so clear now that the clouds have gone. But I can’t help but wonder if they’ve disappeared entirely or just moved somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 乌云散去之后，一切都清楚了。可我忍不住想，它们是彻底消失了，还是只是飘到了别处。

lines.en: : You are not {i}unwanted,{/i} Yasu! But please...do {i}not{/i} attempt to recollect anything in your current state.
lines.zh: : 你不是{i}不被需要{/i}的，Yasu！但求你了……在你现在这种状态下，{i}别{/i}去回想任何事。

lines.en: : You are fine just the way you are — and I’m sure that there’s a very good reason that there are certain aspects of your past that you have suppressed. Digging them up does no one any good.
lines.zh: : 你现在这样就很好——而且我敢肯定，你会把过去的某些片段压下去，一定有充分的理由。把它们挖出来对谁都没好处。

lines.en: : If you ever have a baby, Touka...and that baby can hear God...what will you do?
lines.zh: : 如果有一天你有了孩子，Touka……而那个孩子能听见上帝的声音……你会怎么办？

lines.en: scene yasutoukahallwalk6
: I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Would you believe them even though you can’t hear what they hear? Would you think them crazy if their thoughts don’t match the color of your own?
lines.zh: : 就算你听不见他们听见的东西，你也会相信他们吗？如果他们的想法跟你自己的不是一个颜色，你会觉得他们疯了吗？

lines.en: : I’m...not quite sure, Yasu. I’ve never thought of that.
lines.zh: : 我……不太确定，Yasu。我从没想过这个问题。

lines.en: : That’s why white is safe.
lines.zh: : 所以白色才是安全的。

lines.en: : There are many people who think black is the combination of all colors — but black is nothingness. It’s white that encapsulates every thought and feeling known to man. It’s white that guides us.
lines.zh: : 很多人以为黑色是所有颜色的混合——可黑色是虚无。真正包罗人类所有思想与情感的是白色。指引我们的是白色。

lines.en: : Or guided us.
lines.zh: : 或者说，曾经指引过我们。

lines.en: : I hear nothing anymore.
lines.zh: : 我再也听不见任何声音了。

lines.en: : It’s just silence...no matter where I go.
lines.zh: : 只有寂静……不管我走到哪里。

lines.en: : You may call that a side-effect if you wish...
lines.zh: : 你愿意的话，可以管这叫副作用……

lines.en: : But I will call it a punishment.
lines.zh: : 可我要管这叫惩罚。

lines.en: : Yasu...
lines.zh: : Yasu……

lines.en: : I ask again — do you think I am impure?
lines.zh: : 我再问一次——你觉得我不洁吗？

lines.en: scene yasutoukahallwalk7

: Why does “purity” matter to you in the first place? It speaks little of your character, and its definition varies widely from person to person based on different perspectives of what “purity” even is.
lines.zh: : 说到底，「纯洁」为什么对你这么重要？它说明不了你多少品格，而且它的定义因人而异，取决于每个人对「纯洁」究竟是什么的看法。

lines.en: : It is something that can’t be explained...only felt. So I ask you a third time, and I will slot your answer into the center of our triangle.
lines.zh: : 这是无法解释的东西……只能感受。所以我第三次问你，而我会把你的答案放进我们这个三角形的正中央。

lines.en: : I think you’re as close to “purity” as one could ever come, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你已经是一个人所能达到的最接近「纯洁」的状态了，Yasu。

lines.en: : Does that make you feel any better?
lines.zh: : 这让你好受一点了吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure what to feel, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该有什么感觉，Touka。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahallwalk8
: What if I never hear anything again?
lines.zh: : 要是我再也听不见任何东西了呢？

lines.en: : Will all of this be for nothing? Will all of my work just...vanish once I’m gone?
lines.zh: : 那这一切都白费了吗？我所有的付出，是不是我一走就……烟消云散了？

lines.en: : How will I ever earn my wings?
lines.zh: : 那我要怎么才能挣到我的翅膀？

lines.en: : There’s more to life than religion, Yasu...
lines.zh: : 人生不只有宗教，Yasu……

lines.en: : You can live happily even {i}if{/i} you never hear anything again.
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i}你再也听不见任何东西，你也能活得开心。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahallwalk9
: But it’s so {i}quiet{/i} now...
lines.zh: : 可现在这么{i}安静{/i}……

lines.en: : It’s scary, Touka...It’s so scary.
lines.zh: : 好可怕，Touka……太可怕了。

lines.en: scene pray
: When is the last time you can remember such silence, Yasu?
lines.zh: : Yasu，你记得的上一次这样寂静，是什么时候？

lines.en: : I {i}can’t.{/i} He has always been there. He has always been with me. But no one listened to me at first. And now, some people are {i}starting{/i} to.
lines.zh: : 我{i}想不起来{/i}。他一直都在。他一直跟我在一起。可一开始没人听我的。而现在，有些人{i}开始{/i}听了。

lines.en: : I felt the forming of an earthquake. I felt His rumble in my core. And each time a new set of eyes came into the cathedral, I could feel His hand on my head. But what if...
lines.zh: : 我感觉到一场地震正在成形。我在自己的身体深处感到他的轰鸣。每有一双新的眼睛走进那座教堂，我都能感到他的手按在我头上。可万一……

lines.en: : What if I only felt that because I wanted to?...
lines.zh: : 万一我只是因为想要感觉到，才感觉到的呢？……

lines.en: : What if I only {i}heard{/i} those things because I wanted to?...
lines.zh: : 万一我只是因为想听见，才{i}听见{/i}了那些声音呢？……

lines.en: : What if the symbols and prayers and doctrines and {i}everything{/i} is all just made up?! What if it’s all a lie, Touka?! Just what does it mean to sin if there is no one there to determine what sin {i}is?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 万一那些象征、祷告、教义，还有{i}一切{/i}，全都是编出来的呢？！万一这一切都是谎言呢，Touka？！如果没有人去判定什么是罪，那罪又{i}是{/i}什么？！

lines.en: : How am I supposed to live if there is no one to tell me how I {i}should?!{/i} Why do I keep being abandoned time and time again?!
lines.zh: : 如果没有人告诉我该{i}怎么活{/i}，我要怎么活下去？！为什么我一次又一次被人抛弃？！

lines.en: : I just want to rain! But the flood keeps coming! What if it drowns you next?! Or everyone else?! No one can listen if they’ve all been claimed by the sea! And there will be nothing to listen {i}to!{/i}
lines.zh: : 我只想下雨！可洪水一直涌来！万一下一个淹死的是你呢？！或者是其他所有人？！要是大家都被大海收走了，就没人能听了！那也就没有什么可{i}听{/i}的了！

lines.en: : Yasu...I will say this again — there is more to life than religion.
lines.zh: : Yasu……我再说一遍——人生不只有宗教。

lines.en: : {i}Every{/i} faith out there has faced trials and tribulations. But the strongest ones fought back and withstood the test of time.
lines.zh: : 世上{i}每一种{/i}信仰都经历过考验与磨难。但最强大的那些反抗了过来，经住了时间的检验。

lines.en: : But all of them are {i}wrong!{/i} Why do I have to bear the truth all on my own?! Why do {i}I{/i} keep being tested?! I’m a bug! I’m a worm! I’m nothing! I can’t do it!
lines.zh: : 可它们全都是{i}错的{/i}！为什么这份真相要我一个人扛？！为什么被考验的一直是{i}我{/i}？！我是只虫子！我是条蛆！我什么都不是！我做不到！

lines.en: : Yasu...you need to understand that members of other faiths think {i}they’re{/i} right as well. You can’t just claim to know truths that are {i}impossible{/i} to know.
lines.zh: : Yasu……你得明白，其他信仰的人也认为{i}自己{/i}是对的。你不能随口就说自己知道那些{i}根本不可能{/i}知道的真理。

lines.en: : But I {i}do{/i} know them, Touka! I could hear everything just a season ago! But {i}where{/i} is summer now?! How did we make it to a place in time that isn’t meant to be here?!
lines.zh: : 可我{i}就是{/i}知道，Touka！就在一个季节之前，我还能听见一切！可现在夏天{i}在{/i}哪里？！我们怎么会走到一个本不该存在于此的时间点？！

lines.en: : Spring has always existed, Yasu. It is not some foreign concept that doesn’t belong here.
lines.zh: : 春天一直都存在，Yasu。它不是一个不属于此地的外来概念。

lines.en: : It {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: : 它{i}就是{/i}。

lines.en: : You just don’t remember.
lines.zh: : 你只是不记得了。

lines.en: scene yasutoukahallwalk1
This conversation happened three times — each iteration with minor variations.
lines.zh: 这段对话发生过三次——每一次都有细微的差别。

lines.en: The infinity house sucked them into its bowels and left them unstuck in eternity with nothing to do but repeat the same words and mistakes and fears over and over again.
lines.zh: 那栋无限之屋把他们吸进了自己的内脏，让他们卡在永恒里动弹不得，除了把同样的话语、同样的错误和同样的恐惧一遍遍重复，无事可做。

lines.en: It’s been five times now. Time moves faster here. And they’re stuck in the bowels forever. Near the figs and the locust, near the twins and noodles. Near Heaven and hell and heaven and Hell.
lines.zh: 现在是第五次了。这里的时间走得更快。而他们永远被困在那副内脏里。在无花果与蝗虫旁边，在双胞胎与面条旁边。在天堂与地狱，以及天堂与地狱旁边。

lines.en: This is what happens when you let a heretic into your home. This is what happens when a lord lashes out.
lines.zh: 这就是把异端放進家里的下场。这就是主发怒时的下场。

lines.en: Every single god in every single cubicle has one thing in common — they need to be believed in in order to exist.
lines.zh: 每一间隔间里的每一个神都有一个共同点——他们必须被人信仰，才能存在。

lines.en: That’s the secret to killing one. That’s why every time a god dies, it is {i}us{/i} who did it.
lines.zh: 这就是杀死一个神的秘诀。所以每当有神死去，动手的都是{i}我们{/i}。

lines.en: Will you remember that when you have to?
lines.zh: 到了那个时候，你会记得这一点吗？

lines.en: Will you remember {i}me{/i} when you have to?
lines.zh: 到了那个时候，你会记得{i}我{/i}吗？

lines.en: Will you remember the rocks or the twins or the noodles or figs or the locusts or the fibers or any of the things that make you you when you so desperately search for the truth?
lines.zh: 当你拼命寻找真相的时候，你会记得那些石子、那对双胞胎、那些面条、无花果、蝗虫、纤维，或者任何构成「你」的东西吗？

lines.en: Because that truth is unlike other truths. It’s one you can’t find unless you abandon everything else. It’s one that appears to you when nothing else will.
lines.zh: 因为那个真相跟别的真相不一样。你只有抛弃其他一切，才能找到它。它会在其他一切都无能为力的时候，出现在你面前。

lines.en: And it’s tangible. You can hold it. Just know that it will corrupt everything you ever touch from that point onward.
lines.zh: 而且它是有形的。你能把它握在手里。只是要知道，从那一刻起，你触碰的一切都会被它腐蚀。

lines.en: What if I told you there was more to life than this?
lines.zh: 如果我告诉你，人生不止于此呢？

lines.en: What if I told you nothing {i}isn’t{/i} real?
lines.zh: 如果我告诉你，没有什么东西{i}不是{/i}真实的呢？

lines.en: The answer is black and white.
lines.zh: 答案是非黑即白。
